item: Unreadable settings still refuse the update and the AI install, but the refusal says the settings could not be read (code settings_unreadable) instead of claiming protected mode is on
summary: What is refused is unchanged (R117): protected_mode_chosen and ai_install_protected stay True when the settings cannot be read. protected_reason() gives the update and the AI install one shared reason code; SettingsUnreadableRefused subclasses ProtectedRefused; SafetySettings.mode_unknown (never saved or served) marks an unreadable store even when the environment supplies a proxy. Sentence with the way out x12. Release line: When the app's settings cannot be read, the update and the AI install still do not start, but they now say the settings could not be read instead of claiming protected mode is on, and say what to do.
